functions.name: c00_simple_if
functions.source: func c00_simple_if(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { return true }; return false }
functions.derivation: One top-level if adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c01_nested_if
functions.source: func c01_nested_if(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { if b { return true } }; return false }
functions.derivation: The outer if adds 1; the nested if adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c02_triple_nested_if
functions.source: func c02_triple_nested_if(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { if b { if c { return true } } }; return false }
functions.derivation: Three nested ifs add 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

functions.name: c03_if_else
functions.source: func c03_if_else(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { return true } else { return false }; return false }
functions.derivation: The if and its else each add one; else is hybrid.

functions.name: c04_if_elif_else
functions.source: func c04_if_elif_else(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { return true } else if b { return false } else { return true }; return false }
functions.derivation: The if, else-if, and else each add one; else-if is hybrid.

functions.name: c05_three_way_chain
functions.source: func c05_three_way_chain(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { return true } else if b { return false } else if c { return true } else { return false }; return false }
functions.derivation: One if, two else-if branches, and one else add four total.

functions.name: c06_and_sequence
functions.source: func c06_and_sequence(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a && b { return true }; return false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c07_or_sequence
functions.source: func c07_or_sequence(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a || b { return true }; return false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1 and the same-operator || sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c08_mixed_boolean
functions.source: func c08_mixed_boolean(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a && b || c && d { return true }; return false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; &&, ||, && form three logical sequences, adding 3.

functions.name: c09_assigned_boolean
functions.source: func c09_assigned_boolean(a, b, c, d bool) bool { value := a && b; return value; return false }
functions.derivation: A binary logical sequence in an assignment adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c10_while_loop
functions.source: func c10_while_loop(a, b, c, d bool) bool { for a { a = false }; return false }
functions.derivation: One top-level while adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c11_for_loop
functions.source: func c11_for_loop(a, b, c, d bool) bool { for _, item := range []bool{a,b} { _ = item }; return false }
functions.derivation: One top-level loop adds one structural increment.

functions.name: c12_if_with_loop
functions.source: func c12_if_with_loop(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { for _, item := range []bool{b,c} { _ = item } }; return false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; the loop nested inside it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c13_nested_loops
functions.source: func c13_nested_loops(a, b, c, d bool) bool { for _, item := range []bool{a,b} { for item { break } }; return false }
functions.derivation: The outer loop adds 1; the inner loop adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c14_switch_or_match
functions.source: func c14_switch_or_match(a, b, c, d bool) bool { switch a { case true: return true; default: return false }; return false }
functions.derivation: The switch/match/select construct adds one; its alternatives add no further points.

functions.name: c15_select_with_nested_if
functions.source: func c15_select_with_nested_if(a, b, c, d bool) bool { select { case <-left: if a { return true }; case <-right: return false }; return false }
functions.derivation: The select adds 1; the if inside a select case adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c16_try_one_catch
functions.source: func c16_try_one_catch(a, b, c, d bool) bool { defer func() { if recover() != nil { _ = false } }(); if a { panic("x") }; return false }
functions.derivation: Defer itself adds nothing; outer if adds 1; closure nesting makes its if add 1 + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c17_try_two_catches
functions.source: func c17_try_two_catches(a, b, c, d bool) bool { defer func() { if recover() != nil { _ = false }; if recover() != nil { _ = true } }(); return false }
functions.derivation: Defer itself adds nothing; two ifs inside its closure each add 1 + 1 callable nesting.

functions.name: c18_recursive_call
functions.source: func c18_recursive_call(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { return true }; return c18_recursive_call(b, a, c, d); return false }
functions.derivation: The base-case if adds 1; one direct recursive call adds 1 fundamental recursion increment.

functions.name: c19_labeled_goto
functions.source: func c19_labeled_goto(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { goto done }; done: return b }
functions.derivation: The top-level if adds 1 and the goto adds 1 fundamental increment for a jump to a label.

functions.name: c20_defer_cleanup
functions.source: func c20_defer_cleanup(a, b, c, d bool) bool { defer cleanup(); return a }
functions.derivation: A defer statement and its call do not break linear flow; there is no structural flow increment.

functions.name: c21_lambda_decision
functions.source: func c21_lambda_decision(a, b, c, d bool) bool { check := func(value bool) bool { if value { return true }; return false }; return check(a); return false }
functions.derivation: The lambda adds no structural point but raises nesting; its if adds 1 + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c22_if_lambda_decision
functions.source: func c22_if_lambda_decision(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { check := func(value bool) bool { if value { return true }; return false }; return check(b) }; return false }
functions.derivation: Outer if adds 1; lambda if adds 1 + 2 nesting levels (outer if and lambda).

functions.name: c23_nested_callable
functions.source: func c23_nested_callable(a, b, c, d bool) bool { inner := func() bool { if a { return true }; return false }; return inner(); return false }
functions.derivation: Nested callable adds no structural point but one nesting level to its if (1 + 1).

functions.name: c24_comprehension
functions.source: func c24_comprehension(a, b, c, d bool) bool { for _, value := range []bool{a,b} { if value { return true } }; return false }
functions.derivation: The range loop adds 1; its nested if adds 1 structural + 1 nesting.

functions.name: c25_labeled_jump
functions.source: func c25_labeled_jump(a, b, c, d bool) bool { outer: for a { break outer }; return false }
functions.derivation: One loop adds 1; the labeled jump adds one fundamental increment.

functions.name: c26_boolean_operator_sequences
functions.source: func c26_boolean_operator_sequences(a, b, c, d bool) bool { return !(a || b) && c }
functions.derivation: The expression has an || sequence followed by an && sequence, for two fundamental increments; negation adds none.

functions.name: c27_language_idiom
functions.source: func c27_language_idiom(err error) bool { if err != nil { return false }; if err != nil { return false }; if err != nil { return false }; return true }
functions.derivation: SonarGo exempts an if err != nil guard without else (sonar-go CognitiveComplexity.isErrorCheckGuard; test error_check_guard_not_counted), so the three guards add nothing. The score-grade engine still counts 3; recorded as a Sonar-rule difference for review.

functions.name: c28_loop_if_boolean
functions.source: func c28_loop_if_boolean(a, b, c, d bool) bool { for _, item := range []bool{a,b} { if item && a { return true } }; return false }
functions.derivation: Loop adds 1; nested if adds 1 + 1 nesting; its && sequence adds 1.

functions.name: c29_else_loop
functions.source: func c29_else_loop(a, b, c, d bool) bool { if a { return true } else { for b { break } }; return false }
functions.derivation: The if adds 1; its else adds 1. The loop in the else body is at nesting level 1, so it adds 1 structural + 1 nesting, totaling 4.
